REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL (CC) OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AND SITTING AS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY (SA) TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL (CC) OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AND SITTING AS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY (SA) TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, APRIL 02, 2019
07:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 1451
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM BISHOP, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
4. ADMINISTRATION OF OATH OF OFFICE:
* Deborah Rutkowski-Hines, Library Board Trustee
* Christina Fraga-Saenz, Housing Authority Commissioner
5. PRESENTATION:
5.1 Palmdale Animal Care Center representative will present a cute critter that is available for adoption from our local Animal Care Center.
5.2 Presentation by Mrs. Donita Winn to Council regarding the upcoming Aerospace Valley Regional Robotics Competition.
5.3 Presentation by Trish Jones, Community Programs Coordinator, introducing the pilot members of the Palmdale Ambassadors Program and providing a brief overview of the Program. The Palmdale Ambassadors are as follows:
* Ronita Cole
* Maria James
* Lauren Lee
* Patty Lendio
* Diana Love
5.4 Presentation by Mayor and Council of Certificates of Recognition to the Palmdale Blue Stockings commemorating their opening season.
* Steven "Gimmee" Moore
* George "Coach" Stergious
* Wes "Flip" Stergious
* Steve "Hack" Stergious
* Travis "Skip" Leland
* Michael "Cheeks" O'Toole
* Clayton "Knuckles" Weber
* John "Woody" Smutny
* Matt "Jeeves" Butler
* Steven "Hightower" Van Ornum
5.5 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Proclamation to Mary and Louis Denning, representatives of the Walk on Words Program, proclaiming April as National Poetry Month in the City of Palmdale.
5.6 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Proclamation to a representative from Donate Life proclaiming April as DMV/Donate Life Month in the City of Palmdale.
6. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S) and ORDINANCE(S):
Staff Recommendation: Waive full reading of the Resolution(s) and/or Ordinance(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
7. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEM NOS. 8.1 THROUGH 8.29 (CONSENT CALENDAR):
Staff Recommendation: Approve the recommendations and findings on items listed under this Consent Calendar, except items nos. 8.6. 8.3 8.11
8. CONSENT CALENDAR:
